reason: I already have my routine with Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out. A foil sachet every day is 30 pieces of packaging per box, and that bugs me. My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, so I would get a blood test before adding something new.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and 'could be low' is not a confirmed deficiency, so I do not want to add another daily thing yet.
would_change_my_mind: A blood test showing my magnesium is actually low, plus a bottle or recyclable pack option instead of 30 foil sachets.
